paragraphs: [Gittin 58a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.58a.14-15) relates that his daughter Tzafenat was taken captive. Her captor abused her all night; the next day he took her out to sell her, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The biblical parenthesis points to a separate occurrence of the name, written Peniel and read Penuel.
The linked story names Tzafenat bat Peniel and describes her as the daughter of a High Priest. It then recounts her captor’s abuse and his attempt to sell her.
